description: This PHP class defines an API endpoint for managing 'My Leave Requests' in an HRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, and updating leave requests, integrating with authentication and leave service traits, and contains detailed OpenAPI annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: MyLeaveRequestAPI
classes.description: A PHP class that provides API endpoints for managing 'My Leave Requests' in an HRM system, supporting retrieval, creation, and update functionalities with integrated authorization and leave service logic.

methods.name: getLeaveApplicationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the LeaveApplicationService instance.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific leave request by ID, inheriting behavior from the parent API class.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a list of the current user's leave requests, with filtering, pagination, and detailed modeling.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Allows the authenticated user to submit a new leave request, handling service invocation and response formatting.

methods.name: checkLeaveRequestAccessible
methods.description: Verifies that the current user has permission to access the specified leave request.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a leave request, inheriting behavior from the parent class.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; attempting to delete a leave request will throw an exception.
